mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_execution (execution_id, order_no, exec_seq, exec_quantity, exec_price, exec_amount, exec_time, business_date) VALUES (#{executionId}, #{orderNo}, #{execSeq}, #{execQuantity}, #{execPrice}, #{execAmount}, #{execTime}, #{businessDate})
mapper.select: SELECT order_no FROM t_execution WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} LIMIT 1
